You sweep a ring of light around your companions, its edge rising like a thin glass wall when magic strikes.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and willing allies within 2 squares when used.
Duration
Until the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Reapplying replaces your previous ward.
Type
Signature

Each recipient gains 1 Boon to defenses against spells until the start of your next turn. During that time, each recipient gains Stability 2.

Additional rulings

Tags: Magic / Defense
